title: Wutun language - Wikipedia
text: The Wutun language (Chinese: 五屯话; pinyin: Wǔtúnhuà) is a Mandarin - Amdo - Bonan creole language. It is spoken by about 4,000 people, most of whom are classified as Monguor (Tu) by the Chinese government.
